leadText:
Cold Storage Battle (Japanese: VSキュレムI VS Kyurem I), titled VS Kyurem I in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 536th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 12th chapter of the .

It is subtitled Kyurem I (Japanese: コンテナ・バトル Container Battle) in the VIZ Media translation and Cold Storage Battle in the Shogakukan Asia translation.
